unit_mapping.SPARTA: SI with species mass1.380649e-23kg equals SI kB numerically, T0=1K,v0=1m/s,length0=1m,n0=1/m^3
unit_mapping.collision: SPARTA VSS alpha1,omega.5,diam=sqrt[1/(sqrt(2)*pi)],referenceT1 => constant HS cross section; monatomic internal modes0

independence: Unmodified official SPARTA serial mac target versus authored NumPy disjoint-pair physical-time Markov approximation; shared physical model only. No primary functions run by SPARTA. Reference derivation/parser are separately reviewable.

time_scope.wall: 24tau0 burn,40tau0 sampling,five8tau0 blocks; reference initial uniform mean wall temperature/zero flow; only stationary observables compared
time_scope.shock: 30tau0 burn,30tau0 sampling,five6tau0 blocks; RH initial jump x8,full incoming drifting-Maxwellian reservoirs,free outflow
time_scope.actual_frames: Retain initial burn-time frame if emitted in raw dump but exclude it from accepted data by exact predeclared time table, not observed field values. Expected sample end times burn+(1..5)*sampleTime/5. All frames/timestamps retained.

acceptance.reference_mesh_and_dt_sensitivity_plus_3: RMS(mean change)<=.03*scale+3*RMS(seed SE); require3*RMS(seed SE)<=.05*scale separately; paired whole-seed differences, not bins/timesteps as replicates

stationarity: Per-seed last2block minus first2block profiles; RMS ensemble drift+3RMS(seed SE) equivalence gate. Retain all5blocks and seed data. Shock adds unaligned lab-frame centroid drift; no profile shifting/pinning or posthoc window choice.
precision: Four independent run seeds; SE from whole seed estimates, t95 df3 separately reported. Spatial-bin/time covariance is retained via per-seed estimators. A large interval cannot make the precision gate pass.
reference_role: Finite-grid stochastic independent HS engine with empirical grid/time/noise qualification, not a rigorous exact Boltzmann reference or proof of infinite-domain/zero-step limit. RH only far-state/flux reference.
failure_policy: Stop on first failed executable/timeout; retain all inputs/logs/raw outputs and complete per-job receipts. No silent retry/seed replacement or threshold relaxation. Qualification failure blocks primary reference use; any later revision is separately reviewed.
